ns2:course.label: Dance Internship
ns2:course.description: (DANCE 320) Supervised field experience in community and/or professional organizations in a variety of danced-related areas. Provides students with work experience and exposure to professional situations. Written and/or video documentation and department presentation of internship activities required. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Major standing in Dance and consent of instructor.
